name: flowops-driver-mobile
description: Capacitor native (iOS + Android) wrapper for the FlowOps Driver PWA. Bundles the existing built driver-portal web app into store-ready apps — no rewrite.

scripts.open:android: npm run sync && cap open android
scripts.open:ios: npm run sync && cap open ios
scripts.run:android: npm run sync && cap run android
scripts.run:ios: npm run sync && cap run ios
